Remove takes a directory out of the dream scope: later dreams leave its
sessions out. What earlier dreams wrote stays. Given a root, it removes the
root (its folders leave the scope, but those added on their own); given a
folder a root holds, it says to add it to the skip list or remove the root.

Usage:
  agent dream scope remove <dir> [flags]

Examples:
  agent dream scope remove ~/src/app

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for remove

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
